experiment: E4 PILOT: how detectable is the sd-vae-ft-mse decoder trace? docs/04-phase4-plan.md Amendment 11 (+ Amendment 7-8 clarifications); diagnostic, does not count toward the stop rule

vae.name: sd-vae-ft-mse
vae.io: identical to 009: uint8 -> float32 [-1,1] -> encode -> latent_dist.mode() -> decode -> (y+1)/2 clamp -> np.rint uint8; fp32, TF32 off; GPU batch 4
vae.note: sdxl-vae is NOT used (Amendment 11 names sd-vae-ft-mse only)

round_trip_save.orig: JPEG at the source file's estimated quality factor (lib/preprocess.jpeg_quality_estimate)

pairs.train: 297 train-split reals (99 native + 99 WA + 99 FBH) + their 297 round-trips; train round-trips are 009's cache (read-only, verified), regenerated for a 16-image/arm consistency check
pairs.test: 1,074 test-split reals (358 per pool, 25 devices) + 1,074 own round-trips, generated here (SD-VAE on GPU)
pairs.groups: CV group = source photo device:vidx (round-trip carries its real's group); bootstrap cluster = device (a pair shares its cluster)

families.F1: B0 primary: DINOv2-base last-layer CLS+mean, 1536-d = last 1536 columns of the 004 secondary matrix
families.F3: fixed low-level residual spectrum, 120-d: per RGB channel (224 center crop of the conditioned image, same crop as the DINOv2 input): r = x - median3x3(x) (x in 0..255, reflect); P = |FFT2(r)|^2 / N, no window; 32 azimuthally averaged log10 power bins over radius 0..0.5 cycles/px (bin = floor(R/0.5*32), R<=0.5; log10(mean P + 1e-10)); plus 8 periodicity values at the latent stride: for f = 1/8,2/8,3/8,4/8 cycles/px along x (fy=0) and along y (fx=0), the log10 power of that exact FFT bin minus the log10 mean power of the 6 neighbouring bins (+-2,+-3,+-4) on the same axis (a peak prominence)
families.F4: F2 + F3 concatenated (standardized inside the probe pipeline)
families.texture: Laplacian texture baseline: mean |4-neighbour Laplacian| of the grayscale 224 center crop of the conditioned image (009 lap224); fixed direction chosen once per condition on TRAIN pairs (the sign that gives train AUROC >= 0.5)

probe: lib/probe.fit_probe: StandardScaler + LogisticRegressionCV, C by 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold (AUROC), class_weight balanced, seed 0

training_protocols.primary: probe fit on CLEAN train pairs, applied to clean and jpeg75_resize05 test pairs (the A0 / 009 convention; the rules are applied to this)
training_protocols.matched: SENSITIVITY (not in the pre-registration): probe fit on train pairs of the same condition (only differs for jpeg75_resize05); rules reported for it as well

measures.pair_auroc: pooled AUROC of probe score (round-trip = high) over the 1,074 own round-trips vs the 1,074 reals; cluster bootstrap by device, 2,000 replicates, one plan shared by all families (paired); pairs share their cluster. Also reported: pair win-rate P(score_rt > score_real) within pairs, per-pool AUROC
measures.transfer: pair-trained probe scored on the 358 test natives vs ALL 120 Synthbuster fakes per generator (009/005 convention; the probe never saw a generator image); macro AUROC over 6 generators, SD-family (stable-diffusion-2, stable-diffusion-xl) vs other (dalle2, dalle3, firefly, midjourney-v5); reals by device, fakes by image stratified per generator (009 Plan)

decision_rules.detectable: best family pair AUROC >= 0.90 clean with CI lower bound > 0.85
decision_rules.survives_laundering: best family pair AUROC >= 0.75 at jpeg75_resize05 with CI lower bound > 0.70
decision_rules.trace_specific: best family beats the texture baseline on pairs by >= 0.10 (reported at clean and at jpeg75_resize05; headline = clean)
decision_rules.best_family: argmax of the test pair-AUROC point estimate over F1..F4 within the condition (selection among 4 on test is optimistic; all families are listed)
decision_rules.consequence: if not detectable or does not survive laundering, VAE-trace methods are deprioritized in the Phase 5 design

d008.vae: reuse 009's pixel guard for sd-vae-ft-mse (max |dpixel| 9.2e-5 x1, same weights revision, same recon function) after checking revision/IO strings are identical; plus a 16-image/arm regeneration check against 009's cached train round-trips
d008.probe: 32 test round-trips per arm, DINOv2 features on CPU vs the CUDA cache, max |dlogit| <= 1e-3 for every probe of every family (F3 is numpy on CPU for both)
